available_signal_cards.description: Judge whether financing, restructuring, or listing actions materially change runway, dilution, or tradability.

Elevated cash burn rate: the ratio of absolute operating cash outflow to cash and cash equivalents is high, indicating rapid cash consumption. Positive when point-in-time evidence shows operating cash outflow is negative and the ratio meets or exceeds the threshold, or documents explicitly describe a high cash burn rate. Negative when evidence shows positive operating cash flow, no material cash consumption, or an explicit denial/cancellation of a high burn. Neutral for proposals, memoranda, non-binding intent, lookalikes, or below-threshold mentions. Unavailable when adequate point-in-time evidence is missing.
Read the latest point-in-time cash and equivalents balance.
Measure the ratio of latest CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue to latest LiabilitiesCurrent for a company as of a point in time. Higher values indicate stronger short-term liquidity.
Measure the latest point-in-time change in gross margin.

Assess a company's estimated liquidity runway in months, computed as latest point-in-time CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue divided by the absolute monthly-average NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities over the reported period. A runway at or below 6 months is positive evidence of near-term financing dependence; a runway at or above 12 months or explicit denial/cancellation of a low-runway condition is negative; intermediate or non-qualifying narrative is neutral; insufficient point-in-time inputs are unavailable.
Measure year-over-year net share retirement, with dilution represented as a negative value.
Measure operating cash flow as a share of revenue for the latest exact reported duration.
Measure whether year-over-year revenue growth is accelerating versus the prior comparable period.
Measure the latest point-in-time year-over-year revenue growth.
Judge whether fresh management guidance materially strengthens the growth path versus prior guidance.
Measure maximum drawdown from the point-in-time one-year price series.
Measure total return across the latest 126 intervals in the chronological adjusted-close series.
Count configured negative terms in complete point-in-time company news source documents.

Within the lookback window, the company or its official filings/press releases disclose a new customer order, contract, offtake agreement, or binding award with a named counterparty or named program and a stated or implied value, volume, or delivery schedule. Materiality threshold: value >= $1M or volume >= 1000 units.
Judge whether a previously non-commercial technical product or technology has become sellable and repeatable; ordinary output from mature operations is not applicable.

hypotheses: If Air Products discloses within the six-month horizon a credible path to double adjusted close from the evaluation anchor baseline, such as major project monetization, large buybacks, or earnings acceleration, then the doubling outcome becomes more likely.

If the new board leadership announces a strategic review or CEO succession that the market interprets as value-unlocking, then the stock could re-rate toward the doubling threshold within the horizon.
If NEOM Green Hydrogen Company or Jazan project financing disclosures reveal cost overruns or delays within the horizon, then the doubling outcome becomes less likely.
